note: Optional directions are not minimum obligations. Status reflects this proposal and supplied evidence; deferred or unverified items are retained without adoption claims.

leads.title: OME-Zarr 0.5 derived-image export
leads.detail: Potential interchange for eligible derived rasters with named axes, scale/translation and labels; only use where the proposed frame maps losslessly. NGFF 0.5 is pinned in S1.
leads.status: opportunity; validate writer/reader round trip before adoption

leads.title: napari plugin or embedded viewer
leads.detail: The supplied napari docs describe lazy array layers, multiscale images, unit-aware rendering, and shapes (S2-S4). Keep as the initial canvas prototype or fallback; the captures are moving docs and do not pin a software release.

leads.title: QuPath as a platform alternative
leads.detail: Project references, relocation practices and export caveats are documented in S12-S14. Could fit if whole-slide imaging dominates; volume/time-series fit remains to be assessed.
leads.status: plausible alternative; not selected for current proposal

leads.title: image.sc community discussions
leads.detail: A possible way to track instrument-specific metadata issues; not treated as primary evidence or inspected for this proposal.

leads.title: Additional vendor readers
leads.detail: CZI, NDPI/BIF, proprietary containers and stitching readers may be added behind the reader interface if researchers need them. Each needs licensed test fixtures and calibration/axis tests.

leads.title: GPU-assisted rendering or decoding
leads.detail: The workstation allows an optional GPU. Keep renderer boundaries flexible, but first measure CPU/tile behavior and correctness.
leads.status: deferred; no GPU claim or test

leads.title: GeoJSON interoperability and coordinate reference
leads.detail: The frozen seed raised a GeoJSON CRS concern but did not supply RFC 7946 source text. This proposal makes no normative RFC claim; target-specific coordinate and format behavior needs research and round-trip testing.

leads.title: ITK/SimpleITK physical-coordinate model
leads.detail: Potential model to investigate if registration or broader medical-image geometry is added. No source capture or component test is included here.

leads.title: Assisted segmentation
leads.detail: Could be considered if annotation throughput becomes a bottleneck; any result would need to be labeled as algorithm-assisted with model/version and provenance. No segmentation evidence collected here.

leads.title: OMERO or cloud exchange
leads.detail: Could support future managed sharing, but the current group exchanges project snapshots through ordinary storage. NGFF's cloud-oriented context does not establish a ready cloud workflow for this app.
leads.status: out of v1; preserve as future alternative

leads.title: tifffile xarray/coordinate helpers
leads.detail: The frozen catalog mentioned recent tifffile coordinate/xarray APIs as an import-inspector lead; this proposal does not rely on those APIs and the supplied capture is incomplete at its tail.
leads.status: implementation lead; verify against exact pinned release and team files

leads.title: napari layer undo behavior
leads.detail: Do not assume viewer-layer undo satisfies persistent project history. The proposal owns its command journal; library behavior may be examined after version pinning.

unresolved_critical_dependencies.dependency: Bounded reads meet interaction and memory targets for actual supported layouts
unresolved_critical_dependencies.evidence: tifffile documentation describes region/page/tile mechanisms (S5); no representative benchmark executed

unresolved_critical_dependencies.dependency: Streaming source identity hashing is practical for 3 GB inputs
unresolved_critical_dependencies.evidence: Design inference only; no hash-time measurement on target data or storage

unresolved_critical_dependencies.dependency: Calibration and axes can be interpreted safely for each supported instrument
unresolved_critical_dependencies.evidence: TVIPS #319 documents a real reported unit-semantic regression and fix chain (S7-S10); no team fixtures tested

unresolved_critical_dependencies.dependency: Generation/commit-marker and export recovery works on actual shared storage and desktop platforms
unresolved_critical_dependencies.evidence: rename(2) describes Linux semantics and NFS caveat (S15); W3 is only a retained local check; no SMB/NFS test

unresolved_critical_dependencies.dependency: Chosen canvas supports required keyboard, editing, scoping, and cancellation workflows at pinned version
unresolved_critical_dependencies.evidence: napari docs describe mechanisms but not this app's complete workflow or a version-pinned result (S2-S4)

unresolved_critical_dependencies.dependency: Pixel-center versus pixel-edge mapping for external annotation formats/tools
unresolved_critical_dependencies.evidence: QuPath states full-resolution pixel units and top-left origin but does not settle center/edge equivalence in the cited passage (S13); W4 tests only supplied arithmetic
